def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-height divider separates aligned panels. Mark the overlap of
    # zero-valued cells in those panels as 3; all other output cells are 0.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[3 if a == 0 and b == 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
            for x, y in zip(left, right)]
